name: polaris
description: The Polaris GPU cloud (polaris.computer) as a mod protocol module. Four things live behind one base URL and the published quickstart documents only the first: a public catalog of GPUs and CPU boxes billed by the second, rentals you SSH into, sixteen one-click template deployments (Ollama, Jupyter, ComfyUI, LangFlow, n8n, agent runtimes, raw docker), and a 400-model inference catalog with per-token pricing — plus the billing, quota and event tape behind all of it. This module normalizes every one of them to mod's verbs: search the catalog, quote before you commit, rent behind a spend guard, list what is burning money right now, and stop, which is the only thing that ends the billing. One implementation serves the CLI, the REST API, the browser console and seventeen MCP tools, so an agent and a human drive identical code. BYOK throughout: the key is the caller's own, resolved from POLARIS_KEY or ~/.mod/polaris/api_key at 0600 — never config.json, never the repo.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

upstream.note: no OpenAPI document is published; the routes wrapped here were mapped against the live API

endpoints.rent: POST /rent {gpu_type, name, hours, confirm, spot, quantity, ssh_public_key}
endpoints.status: GET /status — money, boxes, deployments, hours of runway
endpoints.identity: GET /identity — the SSH public key this module rents with
endpoints.raw: POST /raw {path, method, body, params} — Polaris's own API

auth.open: info, health, gpus, pricing, templates, models, quote, packs, tools — reading a catalog spends nothing and reveals nothing about the operator
auth.byok: instances, ssh, deployments, logs, activity, account, credits, history, usage, stats, keys, status — allowed when the caller sends their own key, because then it is their account being read
auth.proof: Authorization: Bearer `m polaris/token`, or a request from localhost that did not pass through the gateway

byok.rule: every call spends the caller's own credits — this module holds no house key

env.POLARIS_KEY: the caller's Polaris API key, checked before the keystore
env.POLARIS_CONFIRM_USD: spend guard: rentals estimated above this need confirm=true (default 0.50)
env.POLARIS_TIMEOUT: seconds any one upstream call gets (default 45)
env.POLARIS_CACHE_TTL: seconds a catalog read is reused for (default 30)
env.POLARIS_TEST_LIVE: 0 to skip the tests that touch the live API

billing.guard: a rental estimated above POLARIS_CONFIRM_USD is refused unless confirm=true, and the refusal carries the quote
billing.truth: `hours` prices the quote only — an instance bills until stop, not until the hours run out
billing.status: active over $5, low_balance under it, restricted at zero where new instances are refused

siblings.compute: orbit/compute aggregates Polaris alongside thirteen other markets as provider `polaris` — use it to compare prices across markets, and this module for everything Polaris does that a generic compute interface cannot express (templates, deployments, the model catalog, billing)
